escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster poster still, vertical, with real depth of field: the instant a leader deploys her squad of agents inside a vast dark hangar at night): Nexa stands CENTERED in the frame, framed from the waist up, a heroic medium shot; above her head a tall, empty expanse of dark hangar air fills the whole upper third of the frame, so her face sits a little below the middle of the frame height. Her LEFT hand (on the right side of the frame) is raised palm up at chest height, about thirty centimetres in front of her face, and on her palm burns a FIST-SIZED CORE of azure-white light, the brightest thing in the frame; her other arm hangs relaxed at her side behind the console, a single hand action. From the core, exactly two thin streams of azure light fly away from her, one back and to the left, one back and to the right, into the depth of the hangar, always at shoulder height or lower, never rising toward the top of the frame. LIGHT: the core is the only key light on her: hard, from below and to the right, so the right side of her face, her glasses, her raised hand and the white plates of her shoulder and chest glow azure, while the left side of her face (on the left of the frame) falls into deep shadow with the nose shadow legible on her cheek. NO fill light, NO front light, no light at all from the camera side: her face is lit only from below-right by the core. A low cool rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulders. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about two meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened, she does not lean toward the lens; her shoulders are clearly wider than two head-widths and her torso and arms read full and strong. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and she looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with calm conviction, razor-thin focus on her eyes. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate on her left side exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small SILVER hoop earrings (silver, never gold), NO watch, NO bracelet, NO ring. THE SPARKS, copied EXACTLY from their two references, each smaller than her head, all above her waist and below her eyes, never arranged in a symmetric arc: the Reports Spark hovers just above the core on her palm, sharp, lit from below by the core, its bar-chart model glowing, pointing at the tallest bar; the Research Spark is PERCHED ON HER RIGHT SHOULDER (on the left side of the frame), one small hand resting on her shoulder plate, holding its magnifying glass to its side and peering toward the core, half in her shadow, sharp. Both Sparks are lit only by the scene light and obey the same depth of field as everything else, never a clean product shot. FAR AWAY in the haze, four to six meters behind her and never higher than her shoulders, EXACTLY TWO more Sparks and no others: ONE far behind her on the left side of the frame and ONE farther still on the right side of the frame (so the whole frame holds FOUR Sparks in total: two near, two far, never five, never six), the same figures as the two Spark references, small in frame and clearly OUT OF FOCUS, reduced to soft shapes whose azure LED eyes read as glowing dots, each catching the end of one stream. The Reports Spark is half in shadow on its far side, lit only by the core. Thin haze catches the streams and the core. COMPOSITION FOR A CIRCULAR CROP: her face, the core and the two near Sparks all sit inside the central circle of the frame. The TOP third of the frame is calm, cool, deep navy-black hangar air with only faint haze and visible texture, never warm or brown: no ceiling lights, no streams, no Sparks, no beams and no bright spots. Nexa is the only person in the whole hangar: no other people anywhere, not even far away or out of focus. The console in front of her is bare matte rubber with nothing on it: no mugs, no notebooks, no papers, no screens. COLOUR TEMPERATURE: the whole frame is cool and contemporary: every light in it is azure or cold blue-white; nothing is warm, amber, orange or golden; no tungsten, no retro glow. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No logos of any other brand, no readable text.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte rubber bumper of the launch console she stands behind, a thick rounded edge whose top surface is also in deep shadow, the lens only a few centimetres behind it, filling the lowest fifth of the frame across its whole width in front of her waist, completely out of focus, with no reflections, no glints on its edge, no screens and no light reaching it

texto.muro: calm, deep dark hangar air above her head, with only faint haze and visible texture
